native/resume-token/current.reason: Wire-level boundary placement during resume replay. Production was consistent across the two runs (r1 nmuuicyas, r2 nmuukwo6n): ADD[1], boundary+token, change b, boundary+token, CURRENT[1]+token, boundary+token. fireemu strict sends: ADD[1], boundary+token, change b, CURRENT[1]+token, boundary+token | filters 1:2:0:0:0. Native-gRPC client effect: a raw gRPC listener sees the boundary frames production sends between the replayed changes and CURRENT, and fireemu does not send them. SDK effect not measured: from the Web SDK source a reconnect that stays online raises a remote event at every global boundary, so production may give an intermediate fromCache:true snapshot where fireemu gives the document together with CURRENT; an online-reconnect case in packet L2 is the way to measure it. Issue fs-listen-resume-replay-boundaries. fireemu also sends the count-only existence filter its rule gives every strict resume of a query target without an expected count (the four rows that carry one: older, other-query, without-expected-count, expired/expired); production sent none here. What decides between production's two answers is not recorded. Accepted by the coordinator's ruling of 2026-10-05 on two conditions. First, the extra filter's count is always correct: it is the number of documents the target matches at that snapshot, so a client that held the target's state at its token holds exactly that many after the replay unless a document it held has left, and then its set exceeds the count by exactly the departed documents (the case where production's own answer to such a resume leaves the removals to the count); the property test the_filter_of_a_resume_leaves_the_client_with_nothing_to_repair_unless_a_held_document_left (crates/fireemu-adapter-grpc/tests/streams.rs) checks this over random histories before and after the token, including limit queries, and the SDKs send an expected count, for which the rule does not fire. Second, the acceptance depends on the next native packet recording more resume variants to find what decides production's answer (design note: L1b resume variants, docs.local/submissions/l1b-resume-variants/design.md); until then rule R stays a fit with this declared counterexample.
native/resume-token/current.production: ADD[1], boundary+token, change b, boundary+token, CURRENT[1]+token, boundary+token
native/resume-token/current.fireemu: ADD[1], boundary+token, change b, CURRENT[1]+token, boundary+token | filters 1:2:0:0:0
